== Actual physical and source-image chronology ==
Actual physical [[:File:Dagobah-D-bossk-hires.webp]] supplies only uncovered upper fields for the June 2017 lower cutout. The canonical [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf]] cover says official text as of June 1, 2017; it does not establish a first release day. The located image order begins with the PC gallery face captured 2007-12-16 (bronze disc), followed by the lower E cutout, located 2018 full image, then later full D-E1 image dated by the located authored UTC record 2022-11-12T02:32:29Z. Native before/after crops and full-source layout comparisons are separate from credited fan recreations. Actual Glossary 1998 page 29 supplies the separate documentary words; later image publication is not a claim that the PC originated that replacement. Current executable <code>4_92</code> stays on [[Bossk (PC Errata 4)]]; no historical executable ID is invented. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 14 November 2026 (UTC).

The earlier actual PC gallery image is preserved at [[Bossk (PC Errata)]], captured 2007-12-16. It is an illustrated digital source, not a physical printing. Its verified CDX SHA1 matches the exact source bytes. Numbering follows located source chronology; no earlier executable ID is invented.
<!-- end retained discussion -->
